`--exclude` should honor the project’s environment default convention so CI can configure which files to omit.

## Changes

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` argument, the parser returns an empty pattern list. The rule in `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` says, “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that set `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` can produce archives containing files they intended to omit.
